hypotheses.D0_target_collection_is_numerically_exac: The upstream dynamic JVP and direct Layer-16 write path retain maximum validation error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.D1_shared_pca_rank8_is_sufficient: A fixed rank-8 FineWeb PCA behavior subspace retains at least 0.90 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.D2_shared_dictionary_four_atoms_are_suff: Four fitted coefficients in one frozen 128-atom dictionary retain at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D3_learned_dictionary_beats_random: At sparsity four, the learned dictionary exceeds the random-dictionary 95th percentile by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D4_learned_dictionary_beats_prototypes: At sparsity four, the learned dictionary exceeds a matched frozen training-prototype dictionary by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D5_shared_dictionary_transfers_ood: Four-atom OOD fidelity is within 0.05 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.D6_shared_dictionary_approaches_per_cont: The shared dictionary reaches 90% with at most eight atoms on every corpus.
hypotheses.D7_validation_selects_noninitial_diction: At least one MOD update improves validation four-atom fidelity over the initialized prototype dictionary.
